messages:
maya (AE): Zoe says the demo stream cut mid-response and the UI shows a JSON parse error. Sending console snippet.

zoe (client-dev): Repro: start streaming -> first 2 chunks render -> then error: 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. Chrome 121, home wifi. Happens ~30% runs.

leo (SE): Can you paste the last raw SSE payload? Hosted trial?

zoe (client-dev): Hosted trial. Console: 

`data: {"id":"r1","delta":{"content":"Hello"}}data: {"id":"r2","delta":{"content":"World"}}`

omar (eng-oncall): That looks like two events concatenated without separators. Edge logs show we wrote both events in one syscall and gateway coalesced them. Also saw a soft rate-limit hit just before connection reset. Possible connector close + proxy buffering = partial delivery.

leo (SE): Short fixes: 1) enable SSE heartbeat comments every 10s, 2) turn on per-event flush for this org, 3) advise client to use exponential backoff and a small reassembly fallback.

maya (AE): Omar, please enable flags for org-zoe-trial.

omar (eng-oncall): Enabling: `sse-heartbeat-poc-zoe` and `sse-flush-per-event-poc-zoe` now. Watch logs for 5 runs.

flag-bot: flags toggled for org-zoe-trial by omar

zoe (client-dev): Running 10 quick demos now. Will report back.

leo (SE): Follow-up: add note to sales POC checklist about webview/proxy buffering and recommend headers to disable buffering for customers (e.g., X-Accel-Buffering: no).

zoe (client-dev): 10/10 succeeded with flags on. No parse errors. Thanks!

maya (AE): Great - ready for the next demo. Leave open for pricing/Dedicated question.
